risks.risk: Burners may not ignite properly (clogged jets, faulty igniters/valves) or may have uneven flame.
risks.proof: A short video of lighting all 4 burners from cold, showing steady blue flame and that each knob controls only its burner.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst case: needs servicing/parts).

risks.risk: Oven may not heat or thermostat may be faulty.
risks.proof: A short video of the oven igniting and reaching a stable temperature (or a thermometer reading) for several minutes.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as oven not proven (worst case: oven not working).

risks.risk: Gas safety issues (leaks at connections/hoses, worn seals, damaged regulator/pipe).
risks.proof: Photo/clip of the gas inlet/regulator connection and a leak test result (soap-bubble test) or a simple demonstration with no bubbles.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as requiring safety check (worst case: leak risk).

risks.risk: Missing/incorrect parts (burner caps, knobs, burner grates, or damaged enamel/liners).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all burner caps/grates and the oven interior/liner, plus a photo of the knob set and control panel markings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as complete but with possible minor missing parts (worst case: parts replacement).

proof_requests: Video: light all 4 burners from cold and show each knob controls its burner (steady flame).
Video: oven ignition and heating for several minutes (show flame/heat).
Close-ups: gas inlet/regulator connection and burner caps/grates; confirm all parts present.
If possible: leak test demonstration (soap-bubble test) at the connection points.
response.reason: The photos show a 4-burner standing gas cooker, but there is no verifiable evidence of ignition, oven heating, or gas safety. To price it correctly in Oyo, you need flame/oven proof and safety/parts confirmation.
